March 12, 2018 - By Ruchi Gupta 
Wms Partners Llc increased its stake in Pfizer Inc (PFE) by 137.16% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wms Partners Llc bought 34,291 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.45% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 59,291 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.12M, up from 25,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wms Partners Llc who had been investing in Pfizer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $218.95 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $36.78. About 2.51M shares traded. Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) has declined 2.76% since March 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.46% the S&P500. 
Centre Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.62% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Centre Asset Management Llc sold 2,530 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 153,348 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $23.63M, down from 155,878 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Centre Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $922.68B market cap company. The stock increased 1.04% or $1.865 during the last trading session, reaching $181.845. About 7.96 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
